Commentary.Commentary: We are up and running in the World Cup! On 11th February, we have two games lined up but first, it will be West Indies Women vs England Women. Do join us at 1830 IST (1300 GMT) for all the action and early for the build up. Till then, cheers!

Sune Luus starts by thanking the crowd to turn up. Applauds the performance of Chamari Athapaththu. Adds it was a par score and feels one game doesn't define their team. Ends by saying there are lots of positives to take from the game.

Chamari Athapaththu wins the Player of the Match! She says she tried her best and wanted to lead her team. Adds it is a team performance and applauds the performance of the bowler. Reckons Vishmi Gunaratne is a superstar. Tells she tries to play her natural game. Feels 140-150 was a par score. Adds the aim is to reach the semi finals. This is her 8th World Cup and hopes to go long way.
...Presentation time....

Sri Lanka Women have shown they are not here just to mess around. First with the bat, Chamari Athapaththu and Vishmi Gunaratne shined and put on a decent score and then the bowlers continued the good work. They came mostly with spinners and everyone made an impact but Inoka Ranaweera was the star with three big wickets. South Africa Women are shell-shocked. They can't belief what happened but this just happened. Sri Lanka Women have registered a famous win.

At first, it looked like Sri Lanka Women were 10-15 runs short but the bowlers stepped up big time. What a bowling performance. Against the mighty South Africa Women they stuck to the planks and rattled them away. South Africa Women though forced things too much. It could have been a well-directed chase but few soft-dismissals didn't help them. Everyone got a start but gave away their wicket. Sune Luus and Jafta gave hope but it didn't last long. Only if someone would have stuck around till the end...

What a match! What a win for Sri Lanka! The World Cup is here with a bang and we have an upset on the very first day! The hosts are shoved away by Sri Lanka. Who saw this coming? Well, that is World Cup for you.
FOUR! A famous win for Sri Lanka! THEY WIN BY 3 RUNS! Full and on off, this is lofted over mid off for four.
That will do for Sri Lanka! Very full, outside off, Mlaba mistimes her push on the off side.
Flatter and outside off, Khaka cuts it to point for one.
Fuller and on off, Nonkululeko Mlaba works it to long on for one.

OUT! RUN OUT! Sri Lanka Women are moments away now! On the pads, Ismail flicks it past mid-wicket and calls for two which was never available. Sugandika Kumari throws it to the keeper who clips the bails off. Even a dive doesn't save Ismail.
A full toss outside off. Ismail slams it to long off. The fielder runs across and cuts it off for two.

Outside off, spins away. Khaka swings and misses. The keeper removes the bails and puts up an appeal. The replay shows Khaka had her back foot outside but not when the bails were off. She dragged it back. 13 runs needed. Nothing on the UltraEdge as well.

OUT! RUN OUT! Jafta goes now! Ohh dear! What a game of cricket! Outside off. Ismail fails to flick. It goes off the pads to short third man where the fielder picks with one hand and throws it to the keeper who quickly dislodges the bails. No need to go upstairs.
FOUR! Poor! Full and outside off. Ismail looks to drive but splices it to backward point. The fielder easily lets it through her legs for a boundary. Everyone are feeling the pressure.

OUT! STUMPED! The pressure is on South Africa Women again! Floated, outside off, spins slightly away. Luss comes down the track to go downtown but misses and the keeper removes the bails with ease. This is going right down the wire.
Commentary.Howout: st Anushka Sanjeewani b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, pushed through covers for one.
Wide! Down the leg side, wided.

DRAMA ALL OVER! Tossed up on leg, Luus heaves it to long on. A single is taken and they want one more but there is a massive confusion and both batters almost end at the bowler's end. Inoka Ranaweera fails to pick up cleanly. Jafta then takes the chance to run back and luckily the throw to the keeper is arrived very late.
FOUR! Short again, outside off. Jafta waits on the back foot and cuts it past point for a boundary. 20 runs needed from last two overs.
Outside off, spins in. Jafta looks to cut but misses.
Two more! Tossed up, outside off, Jafta uses the pace and dabs it to short third man. A very poor throw from the fielder. It goes over the keeper and the batters take two.
FOUR! This is short and outside off, Jafta stays back and cuts it past point for a boundary. Much needed.
100 up! Outside off. Jafta opens the face of the bat and steers it to third man for two.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Jafta lofts it over the cover region for a couple. It was in the air but falls safely.
This is outside off. Jafta looks to cut but misses.
On middle, blocked out.
OUT! TAKEN! MISTIMED! Sri Lanka Women believe! Short and outside off, holds onto the surface. De Klerk mistimes her pulls to long on where Nilakshi de Silva takes yet another catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Nilakshi de Silva b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, swept to deep square leg for one.

SIX! BANG! Much needed! Tossed up, around off. Luus skips down and launches it to long on. Gets more height. The fielder is interested in the deep. Could have taken it if she would have stuck to the ropes.
Six singles! This won't help! On off, played to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and outside off, De Klerk sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Down the leg side. Luus mistimes her sweep to short fine leg for one.
Too short and on middle. De Klerk pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, dragged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Touch short and on off, De Klerk pulls it to long on for one.
South Africa Women need boundaries badly! This is way outside off, Luus looks to sweep but misses.
Tossed up on off, De Klerk sweeps to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Luus sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, kept out.
On off, pushed to covers for a single.
Just short! Flat and outside off. De Klerk punches on the up and the fielder at covers collect on a bounce.
Outside off,  Luus dabs it to point.
Flighted on off, De Klerk pushed to cover for a quick single.
An arm ball on off, kept out.
Short and outside off, punched to cover.
Around off, dropped to point for a quick single.
THREE WIDES! This is down leg, Luss misses her sweep. It goes through the legs of the keeper for two more.
On off, kept out.
Fuller and on middle, eased to long on for one.
Full an outside off, driven to cover. The throw was wayward but just a single.

OUT! BOWLED! DRAGGED ON! Sugandika Kumari is pumped up! This is brillint from Sri Lanka! South Africa Women are trying to force things. Again no pace, this is short and outside off. Bosch tries hard to cut but gets a bottom edge back onto the stumps.
Flatter and outside off, Bosch taps it to cover.

OUT! TAKEN! Just when South Africa Women were running away, Sri Lanka strikes! This is the woman in form who goes! Tossed up, outside off, no pace and Tryon tries to slog-sweep but fails to power and Nilakshi de Silva at long on gets on her knee to take it.
Commentary.Howout: c Nilakshi de Silva b Sugandika Kumari

Commentary.Commentary: Well played! Short and outside off, Luus dabs it past short third man for three runs.
On top of off. Luus turns it to mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, dragged to long on for one.
FOUR! Uses the angle! This is down the leg side. Tryon helps it to fine leg for four.
This one spins in on middle. Tryon punches it back to Kavisha.
Tossed up on off, blocked out.
Short and on off, Luus pulls it to long on for one.
FOUR! This will release some pressure! Full and outside off. Tryon opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man for four.
Full and on off, Luus knocks it to mid off for a single.
On a length and outside off, dropped to point.
Leg bye! Sliding on the pads, Tryon misses her flick. A leg bye is taken.
Full and around off, Tryon pushes it to point.
Extra bounce this time! Around off. Tryon looks to defend but it lobs off the shoulder of the bat to backward point.
Tossed up, outside off. Luus carves it through covers for two more. South Africa Women need a big stand now.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers for a single.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! The set batter goes now! South Africa Women in massive trouble! Short and on middle, slower ball. Wolvaardt looks to sweep but gets a top edge, probably gets hit on the shouldr before lobbing behind the keeper. Oshadi Ranasinghe runs back from first slip and takes an easy catch. The umpire at first took her time to raise the finger but eventually she showed the dreaded finger. Wolvaardt knew she got some bat and walks back without reviewing it.
Commentary.Howout: c Oshadi Ranasinghe b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: This is short and down leg. Wolvaardt opens her body to pull but misses.
On off, kept out.
Around off, punched to covers for a single.
Very full on off, eased to long on for one.
Drops it touch shot on middle, pulled to deep square leg for one.
50 up for the hosts! On middle, Luus pushes it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off, Wolvaardt bunts it to mid-wicket for one more.
On middle, this is hit to square leg for one.
Short and on middle, Wolvaardt tucks it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off, Luus defends. Good bowling from Inoka Ranaweera. Sri Lanka Women will be happy with this score line.
Flat and outside off, slapped to deep cover for one.
Full and outside off. Luus drives it to deep cover for one.

OUT! TAKEN! What a big wicket this is! Kapp goes! Tossed up around off, slower through the air. Kapp tries to slog-sweep but it goes from the higher part of the blade. In the hands of Nilakshi de Silva at mid on. Easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Nilakshi de Silva b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on off, Kapp punches it to cover.
Tossed up on middle, kept out.
One more run as Kapp punches it to long on.
Fuller and outside off, driven to deep cover for one.
Full and on middle, Kapp flicks on the up to deep mid-wicket for one.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
On off, pushed to long on for a single.
On middle, Wolvaardt glances it to fine leg for one.
Tossed up on middle. Wolvaardt works it to long on for one.
A single as this is hit to long on.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Well wide outside off. Kapp gets low and drives it crisply through point for four.
Flatter and outside off. Kapp punches it to covers for a single. A slight misfield and another run is taken.
Kapp cannot find the gap!Outside off, this is hit to point.
Full and on off, pushed to cover.
Full and on middle. Kapp pushes it to long on for a single.
OUT! TAKEN! Oshadi Ranasinghe strikes and break the opening stand! Too full and on off. Brits tries to go over cover but plays off the outer half of the bat and Ama Kanchana takes it cleanly.
Commentary.Howout: c Ama Kanchana b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted on middle. Brits flicks it to square leg. Slight mix-up but the fielder was late to pick up the ball.
Too full and on middle, blocked back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Brits comes forward and punches it to cover.
Wide! Way down the leg side. Brits misses her sweep.
Tossed up on off, Brits defends it out.
6 off the over! A full toss, outside off. Wolvaardt drives and finds cover. Got away with that one.
Too full and on middle. Brits drives to the right of the bowler who dives but parries it away for onw.
On middle, eased to mid on for one.
Fuller and outside off, punched straight to point.
FOUR! Gorgeous! This is full, slow and outside off, Wolvaardt leans and drives it through covers for four.
Fuller and outside off, Wolvaardt pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and on off. Brits chips it to mid off.
Fuller and outside off, Brits smashes it hard but finds cover.
No ball! Achini Kulasuriya has bowled another short ball! This is outside off, left alone. A free hit will follow.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler who gets her left leg out and stops.
Wide! Goes full and way outside off, left alone.
FOUR! A length ball, outside off. Brits plays it delicately to third man. The fielder runs across fine and slides but fails to stop.
Wide! Too many extras from Sri Lanka. Short and down leg, left alone.
Short and on middle. Brits goes back and pulls in the gap to mid-wicket for two.
Short of a length and outside off. Brits pulls it wildly but misses.
This one nips in on middle. Wolvaardt again keeps it out.
Length ball, outside off, knocked to point for one more.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! Just over! Full and outside off. Brits swings ard but slices it over short third man for four.
Wide! The keeper again fumbles to collect the ball.
Two wides! Down the leg side. The keeper fails to collect. A single is taken.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
On the hips, this is flicked behind square leg for two.
Tidy start by the Lankans. On middle, Brits gets forward to keep it out.
Short and on middle. Bits didn't expect it to come. She looks to pull but misses and it lobs off the helmet. A concussion protocol is going on.
On a length and on middle, Wolvaardt inside edges her push to mid-wicket for one.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on.
South Africa Women are underway! Length and outside off, Wolvaardt punches it past point for a brace.
This is full and on middle. Blocked out.
